Repository description: "Grafana Tempo is a high volume, minimal dependency distributed tracing backend.". Reviewer summary of the upstream documentation: Grafana Labs' open-source, object-storage-backed distributed tracing backend. Requirement part it addresses (observation-inference): Requirement: 'Observe real native usage/service outcomes through one privacy-filtered local pipeline...'. Tempo is the trace-signal component of that pipeline;

documentation_excerpts.text: Grafana Tempo is an open source, easy-to-use, and high-scale distributed tracing backend.

Distributed tracing helps teams quickly pinpoint performance issues and understand the flow of requests across services. The Traces Drilldown UI simplifies this process by offering a user-friendly interface to view and analyze trace data, making it easier to identify and resolve issues without needing to write complex queries.

limitations: Source and documentation review at the pinned commit only: not installed, executed, benchmarked or compared with any other component.

The description and excerpts are the upstream project's own words at that commit; the reviewer summary was written by a research agent and checked by an independent fit review. Both are upstream claims, not measured results.
